calls.title: Stephen Pavlovich and Chris Sanders
calls.summary: The meeting focused on establishing an experimentation program utilizing GrowthBook to enhance website waitlist signups, booking conversions, and referrals. The team discussed both client-side and server-side experimentation, emphasizing the importance of addressing real business challenges through A/B testing. They reviewed their current tech stack, which includes React Native, .NET C#, and Azure for data integration. Concerns about data handling and legal preferences for self-hosted versus cloud solutions were addressed, alongside the need for documentation to facilitate decision-making. Plans were outlined for a developer training session at the end of July, with communication channels set up to streamline collaboration.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook, experimentation, cloud hosting, data pipeline, developer enablement, Azure
